title: Added 12 realistic cars with interiors to my free AI-made 3D model library
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
Another update to the model library I've been building with Claude. These 12 cars are realistic rather than low-poly: real-world scale, full interiors, and separate wheel and steering wheel nodes, so you can spin the wheels in a game. They include a sedan, a limo, an off-roader, a muscle car, a hot hatch, an EV and a supercar, all original designs with no real brands. GLB, glTF, OBJ and STL, CC BY 4.0, no sign-up.

[https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models/realistic-cars](https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models/realistic-cars)

comments.author: Good-Acanthaceae-136
comments.body:
You're better off putting them as CCO rather than CC BY because if they are AI generated you have no copyright of them anyway so nobody has to abide by any CC BY.

Also they are way too dense for the level of detail they have, plus they are badly made. I only downloaded one to look at and it had parts of the mesh body running through the wheels as well has holes and weird geo in places.

They are the kind of model that would be fine viewed from a distance but then they have way too many polys for that.
